title: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for 2025-2026 taken en bloc in Committee of Supply
what_it_is: The reporting stage of Committee of Supply proceedings on the Supplementary Main Estimates and Supplementary Development Estimates for the financial year 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, followed by a motion that Parliament agree with the Committee's resolutions.
why_it_matters: The resolutions recorded in the transcript supply $1,087,355,800 to the Government under the Heads of Expenditure in the Supplementary Main Estimates and $2,161,019,900 under the Head of Expenditure in the Supplementary Development Estimates, for public services in the financial year 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026. The transcript does not say which services the money goes to or what changes for individuals.

key_points.point: The Heads of Expenditure were taken together rather than voted on individually, because no amendments had been tabled.
key_points.speaker: The Chairman
key_points.quote: As there are no amendments, I propose to take the Heads of Expenditure en bloc.

key_points.point: The Supplementary Main Estimates were taken as Heads E, L, P, S, V, W and Z.
key_points.speaker: The Chairman
key_points.quote: I will first take Heads E, L, P, S, V, W and Z of the Supplementary Main Estimates.

key_points.point: The Supplementary Development Estimates were taken as Heads B, I, L, Q, S, T and W.
key_points.speaker: The Chairman
key_points.quote: they are Heads B, I, L, Q, S, T and W

key_points.point: A sum of $1,087,355,800 was agreed to be supplied to the Government under the Heads of Expenditure in the Supplementary Main Estimates for the financial year 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, contained in Paper Cmd 5 of 2026.
key_points.speaker: The Chairman
key_points.quote: That the sum of $1,087,355,800 shall be supplied to the Government under the Heads of Expenditure for the public services shown in the Supplementary Main Estimates of Expenditure for the financial year 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, contained in Paper Cmd 5 of 2026

key_points.point: A sum of $2,161,019,900 was agreed to be supplied to the Government under the Head of Expenditure in the Supplementary Development Estimates for the financial year 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, contained in Paper Cmd 5 of 2026.
key_points.speaker: The Chairman
key_points.quote: That the sum of $2,161,019,900 shall be supplied to the Government under the Head of Expenditure for the public services shown in the Supplementary Development Estimates of Expenditure for the financial year 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, contained in Paper Cmd 5 of 2026

key_points.point: The Second Minister for Finance reported to Parliament that the Committee of Supply had come to certain resolutions.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: I report that the Committee of Supply has come to certain resolutions.

key_points.point: The Second Minister for Finance moved that Parliament agree with the Committee's resolutions.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: That Parliament doth agree with the Committee on the said resolutions.

what_happens_next: Ms Indranee Rajah moved that Parliament agree with the Committee's resolutions; the transcript does not record any further step.
not_said: Which public services the $1,087,355,800 and $2,161,019,900 will be spent on?
Whether Parliament agreed to the motion that it agree with the Committee's resolutions?
From what date the sums take effect or when they will be drawn down?
What the individual Heads E, L, P, S, V, W, Z, B, I, Q and T cover?
